title: Downloaded exercise clips are never cleared, so the phone's space use grows with every exercise opened
what: Each demo clip (about 570 KB with its still frame) is kept on the phone for good once an exercise is opened. Old files are removed only when a newer version of that same clip arrives. There is no size cap, no clear-out of clips not opened for months, and no way for the member to clear them. Today only 2 clips are approved, but the plan is a clip for each of about 400 exercises, which would be over 200 MB kept forever on a phone that opened them all. The files sit in the app's own folder, so the phone does not clear them when space runs low.
expected: The clip folder has a size cap (for example the most recently opened clips only), or old clips are cleared after a while, or the member can clear them in settings.
who: members on phones with little space
how_often: grows over time as more clips are approved
fix_line: Cap the clip folder size and drop the clips opened least recently
